---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or behavior change
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What is the player-facing problem this feature would solve? A short paragraph or
a couple of bullets is enough.

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you'd like. UI mocks, ASCII art, and links to similar
features in other mods are all welcome.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is this one better?

## Scope

- **Affects gameplay balance?** (yes / no / not sure)
- **Affects save compatibility?** (yes / no / not sure)
- **Localization cost:** (small / medium / large)

## Willing to help

- [ ] I can test pre-release builds on Discord
- [ ] I can write a draft PR for this
- [ ] I can help with translation once the API is stable
